item.summary: fix(agents): scope fall-through plugin registry loads to the active runtime registry (#130167) First hook/cron isolated-run dispatch in a gateway process cold-loaded every discovered plugin (~70 bundled providers) because the registry loader's startup-scope fallback chain came up empty on that path and dropped onlyPluginIds entirely. In dev checkouts each provider plugin loads from TypeScript source through jiti's synchronous babel transform: a CPU profile of a live 13-message gmail hook burst showed one contiguous 42.6s event-loop block (36.2s extension module loading; amazon-bedrock 16.8s, opencode 13.1s), the gateway HTTP server unresponsive for ~31s, and the fan-out handler's own 8s response deadline unable to fire - the livelock recorded in #130002. The fallback chain now consults the process's active plugin registry before giving up to full discovery: explicit base -> request-scope registry -> metadata snapshot pluginIds -> active runtime plugin ids -> unrestricted. resolveAgentRuntimePluginLoadPlan still adds the run's selected provider, harness, memory, and context-engine owners on top, so any selected provider outside the startup set keeps joining the immutable run generat
